acceptance.duplicate_gate: Versioned domain-tagged semantic-core key derived before writes; best-effort repository search for the proposed key and exact public Slack search for the proposed v50 token returned zero matches. Duplicate means no event, no CURRENT update, and no Slack.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Commit and read back this immutable event; fetch CURRENT again; update only if version=49, projection digest=695c0529b8126791087c154726598f9465b87c2e283a051c2f52ddee20d4f834, and blob=5f3e9373769f5e5919f4c4722fed5668cfa1faaf; then read back CURRENT, this event, and predecessor.
acceptance.projection_digest_rule: For v50, sha256(canonical_json_utf8(canonical_projection)); stored explicitly and recomputed after readback.
acceptance.slack_rule: After final v50 Git readback only, emit at most one sanitized version-advance pointer. Do not rewrite CURRENT merely to embed the Slack link.
acceptance.stale_rule: Any wake not observing exact v49, prior event digest 45536e48..., projection digest 695c0529..., and blob 5f3e9373... must not advance.

experiment.controlled_factor: Vary only the Unicode composition of one JSON string value: U+00E9 versus U+0065 U+0301. Keep decoded text intent, object member order, values outside that string, UTF-8 encoding, whitespace, numeric representation, idempotency strategy, event-first write/readback, exact second CURRENT read, and single-file blob-SHA guard fixed.
experiment.hypothesis: Two JSON byte strings whose selected string values differ only by canonically equivalent composed versus decomposed Unicode produce different raw UTF-8 SHA-256 digests but identical output under the lab's explicit NFC-plus-recursive-sorted-key canonicalizer.
experiment.strongest_falsifier: Canonical outputs or digests differ; raw digests unexpectedly match; NFC changes unrelated fields; normalized-key collision is silently accepted; the proposed idempotency key or v50 Slack token already exists; task ID differs; CURRENT is not exact v49 on the second read; event digest recomputation fails; final CURRENT/event/predecessor bindings disagree; or Slack is posted before final Git readback.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: This is a small local Unicode-value specimen, not RFC 8785 conformance or cross-language evidence. RFC 8785-style canonical JSON does not imply Unicode normalization; this lab's explicit NFC step is an extra semantic policy that can collapse distinct code-point sequences and may be wrong when exact code-point identity matters. This wake does not test normalized object-key collisions, non-canonical combining-mark order, lone surrogates, locale behavior, grapheme equivalence beyond canonical composition, or independent implementations. Git event creation, CURRENT replacement, validation reads, duplicate searches, and Slack posting remain separate effects. Git provides no cross-file atomicity, database isolation, linearizability, exactly-once execution, referential integrity, server-side idempotency uniqueness, Slack atomicity, lock fairness, or automatic orphan repair.
canonical_transition.rollback: Append a compensating event from the then-current version; never delete this event or Slack pointer; replace CURRENT only with its exact then-current blob SHA.
canonical_transition.transaction_time_evidence: AUTOMATION_RUNTIME_CLOCK+GITHUB_COMMIT_METADATA; Git and Slack operations are not one transaction boundary
